home.featPackText: Good packing protects your items on the way. Follow these five simple steps before handing over your parcel.
home.packTip1: Use a sturdy box slightly larger than the contents.
home.packTip2: Wrap each item separately and fill empty space so nothing moves.
home.packTip3: Seal every seam with strong packing tape.
home.packTip4: Remove or cover old labels and barcodes.
home.packTip5: Put a copy of the delivery address and your contact details inside the box.

home.statusGuideText: These are the milestones you may see on the tracking page, and what each one tells you.
home.faqText: Quick answers about tracking and sending shipments. Can't find what you need? Contact our support team.
home.faq1Q: Where do I find my tracking number?
home.faq1A: Your tracking number is on the shipping receipt or confirmation you received from our team. It is a mix of letters and numbers, for example WB12345678901.
home.faq2A: The tracking page shows each milestone as soon as our team records it. All times are shown in UTC.
home.faq3Q: Why can't my tracking number be found?
home.faq3A: Check that the number is typed correctly — spaces and dashes don't matter. If it still can't be found, contact us and include the number so we can check it for you.
home.faq4Q: Is the estimated delivery date guaranteed?
home.faq4A: No. The estimated delivery date is our team's best estimate and may change, for example because of customs processing or delays on the way.
home.faq5Q: Who can see my shipment details?
home.faq5A: The public tracking page shows only the status, dates, and the cities and countries of origin and destination. Names, street addresses, phone numbers and email addresses are never shown.
home.faq6Q: How do I send a shipment?
home.faq6A: Send us a message through the contact page with what you are sending, where it is going and when. Our team will reply with the next steps.
home.promoTitle: Shipping regularly? Let's set it up together.
home.promoText: Whether you send a few parcels a month or every day, our team will help you find the simplest way to ship with us.
home.safetyText: Criminals sometimes send fake messages that look like they come from a delivery company. Here's how to stay safe.
home.safetyTip1: Check your tracking number only on our official website, by typing the address yourself.
home.safetyTip2: Be careful with unexpected texts or emails asking you to pay a fee to release a parcel.
home.safetyTip3: Never share card details, passwords or codes through a link in a message.
home.safetyTip4: If you are unsure, contact us directly using the details on our contact page.

about.title: About Westbridge Global Express
about.subtitle: Connecting the World. Delivering with Confidence.
about.placeholderBody:
Westbridge Global Express provides parcel and shipment services for individuals and businesses, with online tracking for every shipment.

Every shipment we handle is registered with its own tracking number. Our team records each step of its journey, so senders and recipients can follow its progress online in English, Polish, Japanese, Spanish and German.

If you have a question about sending or tracking a shipment, our support team is ready to help.

about.value3Text: Our team is available to help with questions about shipments.

legal.privacyPlaceholder:
This privacy policy explains how Westbridge Global Express collects and uses personal information.

We collect the information needed to provide our shipping services, such as sender and recipient names, addresses and contact details, and the information you submit through our contact form.

We use this information to process shipments, provide tracking, and respond to inquiries. We do not sell personal information.

The public tracking page shows only shipment status, dates and locations — not names, addresses or contact details.

The full policy, including your rights and how to contact us about your data, will be published here.
